list.title: Contacts
list.description: Everyone your AI talks to — captured from calls, added by you, or imported.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search name, company, phone or email
list.emptyDescription: Your AI creates contacts automatically from inbound calls. You can also add them yourself or import a spreadsheet.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This removes them from your contact book. Past call logs keep their name.

detail.notFoundMessage: This contact doesn't exist or was deleted.

activity.noCallsDescription: Inbound and outbound calls with this contact will appear here.

editor.description: A contact needs at least a name, a company or a phone number.
editor.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

quickCreate.title: New contact
quickCreate.description: Just enough to raise the document — add company, address and more from the Contacts page later.
quickCreate.emailHint: Optional — where quotes and invoices get sent.

import.title: Import contacts
import.uploadDescription: Upload a spreadsheet — CSV, TXT, XLS or XLSX, up to 10 MB.
import.mapDescription: Match your spreadsheet columns to contact fields.
import.invalidType: Use a CSV, TXT, XLS or XLSX file.
import.tooLarge: The file must be 10 MB or smaller.
import.started: Import started — you'll get a summary by email.
import.expired: The upload expired — choose the file again.
import.matchHint: Rows are matched to existing contacts by phone number.
import.headerRow: The first row contains column headings
import.enrichHint: Rows matching an existing contact by phone enrich it — new phones, emails and tags are added, blanks are filled, and nothing is overwritten. A tags column can hold several tags separated by commas.

bulk.addTagDescription: The tag is added to every selected contact.
bulk.removeTagDescription: The tag is removed from every selected contact that has it.
bulk.tagged: Tagged {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
bulk.untagged: Removed the tag from {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
bulk.dncDescription: Each selected contact's primary number is blocked from outbound calls. Contacts without a phone number are skipped.
bulk.addedToDnc: Added {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}} to the do-not-call list
bulk.deleteAllTitle: Delete every contact matching your filters?
bulk.deleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}?
bulk.deleteDescription: This removes them from your contact book. Past call logs keep their names.
bulk.deleted: Deleted {count, plural, one {# contact} other {# contacts}}

campaign.finished: That campaign has finished — pick another one.
campaign.descriptionAllMatching: Everything matching your filters joins the campaign's recipient list.
campaign.descriptionCount: {count, plural, one {# contact joins} other {# contacts join}} the campaign's recipient list.
campaign.skippedNote: Contacts without a phone are skipped; do-not-call numbers are blocked.
campaign.noCampaigns: No open campaigns — create one first, then add your audience.
campaign.overCap: Up to {max, number} individually-picked contacts per batch — use “Select everything matching” with filters instead.

dnc.title: Do not call (DNC)
dnc.description: Numbers your AI must never call.
dnc.infoDescription: Single calls, campaigns and scheduled callbacks all check this list before dialling; inbound calls aren't affected. Your AI agents add numbers here automatically when a caller asks. This is your business's own list — it doesn't add numbers to the national Do Not Call Me database.
dnc.emptyDescription: Numbers on this list are never dialled by your AI. Add one manually, or your agents will add callers who ask not to be contacted.
dnc.removeDescription: This number becomes callable again — single calls, campaigns and callbacks will all be able to dial it.
dnc.removed: Number removed from the do-not-call list

add.title: Block a number
add.description: Your AI will never place an outbound call to this number. Re-adding a blocked number updates its reason.
add.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Asked us to stop calling
add.added: Number added to the do-not-call list
